newsitem.title: UK: Bunzl in talks to buy bonded fibre business.
newsitem.headline: Bunzl in talks to buy bonded fibre business.

text.p: British-based paper and plastics group Bunzl Plc said on Friday that it is talks over the possible cash purchase of the bonded fibres business of American Filtrona Corp.

It said in a statement that the bonded fibres business is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of cigarette filters and ink reservoirs and would complement Bunzl's worldwide filter and fibre businesses.
Bunzl said the purchase would be made by WBT Holdings LLC, a company owned by several trusts for the benefit of members of the family of the late Walter Bunzl.
The bonded fibre business had sales of $62.9 million and made operating profits of $7.3 million in 1995.
